nodes.description: Current Lottery stage enum value (INITIAL/ACTIVE/FINISHING/ENDING_MINING/COMPLETION/DISABLED); gates nearly every state-changing function.
Boolean reentrancy mutex used by mutexLOCKED modifier and inside mine()/claimWinnerPrize().
Payable address of the Main UniLottery Pool; set once on initialize()/construct() and used by poolOnly.
Address of the randomness provider allowed to call the finish callback.
Uniswap ULT-WETH pair address; presence of this address as sender/receiver distinguishes buys and sells.
Per-transfer keccak chained hash, used as pseudo-random source for finishing and for the alternative random seed.
Mapping of addresses that already claimed their winner prize; written after the ETH transfer in claimWinnerPrize().
Stores lottery net profit computed at lottery end; basis of miner, owner, pool and winner payouts.
MinMaxHolderScores storage struct holding min/max int80 holder score factors used for normalization.
Mapping of HolderData (unchecked int80 score factors, referrer chain, referral id) in LotteryStorage.
uint64 random seed in LotteryStorage, set by callback or by the alternative-seed path in mine().
Immutable delegate logic contract address used by LotteryStub/LotteryStorageStub delegatecall fallbacks.
Array of holder addresses maintained by addHolder/removeHolder, iterated by the winner selection algorithms.
LotteryConfig storage struct controlling profit shares, burn rates, finish criteria and prize shares.
Reference to the LotteryStorage contract holding holder scores and the winner selection algorithm.
Core token transfer override: applies burns, updates holder data and scores, updates transferHashValue, checks finishing/ending conditions.
Payable one-time initializer called by the pool: mints supply, adds Uniswap liquidity, sets pool/exchange addresses and moves to ACTIVE.
Two-step mining function that requests a random seed, removes liquidity, transfers profit shares and pays the miner reward to msg.sender.
Winner prize claim; verifies winner position, computes prize amount and transfers ETH to msg.sender before marking the claimer.
Pool-only function that transfers the remaining contract balance back to the pool after the claim deadline.
Randomness-provider-only callback that stores the random seed and may finalize the lottery.
Rolls transferHashValue modulo the current finish probability and starts the ending stage when the roll succeeds.
Enables or disables the FINISHING stage based on lifetime, holder count, funds and time criteria.
Maintains holder array and updates/propagates holder scores before the actual token movement; enforces the sell-blocking fund requirement.
Removes all Uniswap liquidity, computes total return and profit, and pushes pool/owner shares out of the contract.
Computes randomized final scores for every holder and sorts them with QuickSelect/QuickSort to record winners.
Applies unchecked int80 score deltas to a holder, updates min/max bounds and walks the referrer chain up to depth 10.
Binds a holder to a referrer via a referral ID, grants bonus score and propagates referree counts/scores up the chain.
Generates a referral ID from keccak(holder, tokenBalance, now) and stores it, blocking later referral registration.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls every call with raw msg.data into the delegate logic contract.
External constructor replacement: validates config ranges, initializes the LotteryStorage and persists the config.
View that returns whether an address is a winner and its ranking position via LotteryStorage.
Removes a holder from the holders array by swapping with the last element and popping; no index validity check.
Pushes a new holder address into the holders array and records its index.
Lottery-only setter that truncates the supplied seed into uint64 randomSeed.
Caller-controlled address used for access checks, miner rewards, prize claims and transfer hashing.
Block timestamp (now) used for lifetime, finishing criteria, seed-request waiting time, deadline checks and referral IDs.
Transaction origin; not referenced by this code (only msg.sender is trusted for access control).
msg.sender.transfer(finalPrizeAmount) inside claimWinnerPrize() executed before prizeClaimersAddresses is set.
msg.sender.transfer(currentStepReward) inside mine() after stage/step state changes.
poolAddress.transfer(address(this).balance) inside getUnclaimedPrizes().
Raw delegatecall of msg.data into __delegateContract from the stub fallback, with assembly return/revert.
Unchecked int80/int score arithmetic (additions, multiplications, truncating divisions) in score computation and propagation.
keccak256-based pseudo-randomness derived from transferHashValue/randomSeed, holder address and block data.
sender parameter of _transfer(), the token source used for burn/score accounting.
receiver parameter of _transfer(), the token destination.
amount parameter of _transfer(), the pre-burn transfer quantity.
Burn amount computed from buyer/default burn rate config in _transfer().
Post-burn amount actually credited to the receiver in _transfer().
LotteryConfig memory argument of construct() carrying all lottery parameters.
_storageAddress argument of construct(), the LotteryStorage to bind and initialize.
Signed ETH value of a detected buy/sell obtained from Uniswap router quotes.
Time-weighted score delta computed from now-startDate and the time factor divisor.
rankingPosition argument of claimWinnerPrize(), self-reported winner rank.
Computed prize amount actually transferred to the claiming winner.
Signed int80 score delta passed into updateAndPropagateScoreChanges().
Miner reward for the executed mining step, derived from ending_profitAmount and minerProfitShare.
randomSeed argument supplied by the randomness provider callback.
holder address argument whose score is updated (also used as transfer participant in score propagation).

edges.reason: msg.sender is mixed into the per-transfer hash and into special-transfer checks during _transfer.
The miner reward is transferred to the arbitrary msg.sender that calls mine().
msg.sender is the prize claimant; its claim flag is only written after the ETH transfer.
Any caller reaches the stub fallback which forwards raw msg.data via delegatecall.
Block timestamp drives the lifetime check and indirect probability-based lottery ending.
now - startDate controls maxLifetime and finishing-stage min-time criteria.
now - completionDate gates whether leftover prizes may be pulled back to the pool.
Elapsed time since the random-seed request decides whether the alternative seed path in mine() is allowed.
Referral IDs are generated from keccak(holder, tokenBalance, now), making the ID timestamp dependent.
_transfer calls updateHolderData_preTransfer before burning/transferring tokens.
After every transfer the finishing-stage conditions are re-evaluated.
When on FINISHING stage, _transfer calls checkForEnding to roll for lottery end.
_transfer recomputes transferHashValue by hashing itself with transfer fields.
exchangeAddress is compared with sender/receiver to classify the transfer as buy, sell or plain.
The chained keccak of transferHashValue is reused as a pseudo-random value in the finishing stage.
transferHashValue modulo the finish probability determines whether the lottery ends.
Holder count from the holders array is compared against finishCriteria_minNumberOfHolders.
sender feeds burn classification and score accounting in _transfer.
receiver is used for max-balance checks and score updates.
amount is the basis for burn and finalAmount computation.
burnAmount is derived from amount and the buyer/default burn rate config.
finalAmount = amount - burnAmount is credited to the receiver.
updateHolderData_preTransfer forwards score deltas into LotteryStorage.updateAndPropagateScoreChanges.
buySellValue is computed from router getAmountsIn/getAmountsOut quotes.
timeFactorValue is computed from now-startDate and the configured time factor divisor.
Holder array and score updates are delegated to the bound lotStorage contract.
Buy/sell detection branches on exchangeAddress equality.
holderData int80 score fields are mutated with unchecked signed arithmetic and propagate into referrer entries.
minMaxScores bounds are widened by direct unchecked int80 comparisons and assignments.
Repeated int80 additions along the referrer chain can silently wrap the score factors.
Score delta parameter is added into the holder and referrer accumulators.
Winner score computation and normalization perform unguarded signed multiplications and divisions.
The algorithm loops over the holders array and writes the sorted winner indexes.
randomSeed is mixed with each holder address to derive the randomized final score.
keccak256(randomSeed, holder) modulo RANDOM_MODULO supplies the random score component.
Mining step 0 invokes liquidity removal and profit transfer.
Mining step 1 triggers the winner selection algorithm in storage for the mined algorithm type.
The step reward is pushed to an arbitrary msg.sender, re-entering mine() is only prevented by the manual mutex flag.
reEntrancyMutexLocked is checked/set/cleared around the miner ETH transfer.
ending_profitAmount is derived by subtracting initialFunds from the contract balance in uint128 arithmetic.
Pool profit share plus initial funds is sent to poolAddress via lotteryFinish.
Prize ETH is transferred to msg.sender before the claimer flag is written.
prizeClaimersAddresses[msg.sender] is only set after the external ETH transfer, enabling re-entrant claims if the mutex is bypassed.
The mutex is released after the transfer, so the guard window does not cover state finalization ordering.
The caller-supplied rankingPosition is validated against storage before payout.
finalPrizeAmount is computed, capped by contract balance, then transferred.
Non-mined algorithm types re-derive the winner status through getWinnerStatus.
Winner status resolution reads holder balances and the storage winner structures indirectly.
The whole contract balance is pushed to the pool address in a single external transfer.
Destination of the leftover-funds transfer is poolAddress.
The stub fallback performs a raw delegatecall with caller-controlled msg.data.
The delegatecall target is the immutable __delegateContract logic address.
initialize() locks the pool address to msg.sender, giving that caller exclusive pool rights.
construct() sets poolAddress from an argument after a zero-address one-time lock check.
Validated LotteryConfig is persisted into cfg.
The randomness provider callback writes the supplied seed into storage.
setRandomSeed truncates and stores the uint64 random seed.
generateReferralID writes holderData.referralID and forces a ROOT_REFERRER referrer when none exists.
registerReferral writes referrer, bonusScore and increments referreeCount/accumulated scores up the chain.
removeHolder swap-and-pops the holders array without validating the given index mapping.
addHolder pushes the new holder and stores its index.
Total miner rewards are computed by multiplying ending_profitAmount by the miner share percentage.
Winner prize amount is derived from ending_profitAmount and the configured share percentages.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a parameter used only inside _transfer's burn/score logic, so it normalizes into the _transfer node.
receiver is a parameter used only inside _transfer for balance checks and score updates.
amount is a local transfer quantity that directly feeds the _transfer burn and transfer operations.
burnAmount is a local computation of _transfer with no independent semantic identity.
finalAmount is a local computation of _transfer consumed by the ERC20 transfer call.
config is the construct() parameter that is validated and stored into cfg.
_storageAddress is the construct() parameter used to bind and initialize the LotteryStorage.
buySellValue is a local of updateHolderData_preTransfer used directly as the score delta.
timeFactorValue is a local of updateHolderData_preTransfer passed into score propagation.
rankingPosition is the claimWinnerPrize parameter that selects the prize to pay out.
finalPrizeAmount is the local value transferred by claimWinnerPrize.
etherContributed_change is a parameter of updateAndPropagateScoreChanges applied to holderData and minMaxScores.
currentStepReward is the local miner payout computed and transferred inside mine().
randomSeed is the callback parameter written into the storage random seed.
holder is the parameter of updateAndPropagateScoreChanges whose HolderData entry is updated and propagated.
